# Bahamas at the 1958 British Empire and Commonwealth Games

The Bahamas competed at the 1958 British Empire and Commonwealth Games in Cardiff. It won one gold and one silver medal. It was represented by one competitor, Tom Robinson, who won gold in the 200 yards dash and silver in the 100 yards dash.
Tommy Robinson pictured during the 1958 British Empire Games in Cardiff, Wales.
